Coordinate interviews, collect client feedback, and maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Work closely with the Talent Acquisition team to prioritize vacancies, manage recruitment pipelines, and resolve sourcing challenges. Maintain accurate candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and project status reports. Monitor recruitment KPIs, including CV acceptance rates, time-to-fill, interview attendance, offer acceptance, and joining rates. Ensure compliance with Magnet's recruitment processes, quality standards, confidentiality requirements, and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Strong sourcing, screening, interviewing, and candidate assessment skills. Good knowledge of LinkedIn, job boards, social media recruitment, and Microsoft Excel. Strong communication, organization, follow-up, and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple vacancies, meet tight deadlines, and work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
